description: Verify that TCP in CLOSING returns ACK with proper SEQ/ACK numbers after receiving a segment with OTW SEQ or unacceptable ACK number (RFC 793 §3.4 p37). 2 iterations exercise CASE 1 (OTW SEQ) and CASE 2 (unacc ACK)
approach:
[Objective]
CLOSING is the simultaneous-close state. Same OTW/unacc-ACK corrective-ACK rule as EST/FW1/FW2.

[Scenario — chronological]
Two phases. For each: drive DUT through handshake → CLOSE → FW1 → tester FIN → CLOSING. Then tester sends OTW-SEQ (phase 1) or unacc-ACK (phase 2). DUT corrective ACK.

[Pass condition]
Both phases produce corrective ACKs.

[Fail condition]
Per phase: handshake / CLOSE FIN / closing ACK / probe ACK missing.

verdicts.Pass: DUT corrective-acked in CLOSING (OTW + unacc) — normal
verdicts.Fail_p1_no_closing_ack: No DUT ACK in CLOSING transition phase 1
verdicts.Fail_p1_no_probe_ack: No DUT ACK to OTW-SEQ in CLOSING
verdicts.Fail_p2_no_closing_ack: No DUT ACK in CLOSING transition phase 2
verdicts.Fail_p2_no_probe_ack: No DUT ACK to unacceptable ACK in CLOSING
